subject.title: fix(memory): keep implicit embeddings recall available

question: Should implicit OpenAI embedding authentication failures preserve compatible existing memory indexes through read-only FTS recall, while explicit remote-provider configuration continues to fail closed?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and proof-positive, but it intentionally changes the compatibility contract for existing implicit-memory setups during provider or credential outages.

options.title: Adopt FTS-only degradation
options.body: Accept read-only lexical recall for implicit-provider outages and keep semantic-index writes blocked until the provider recovers.

options.title: Keep fail-closed implicit behavior
options.body: Require the existing unavailable-search behavior until an explicit product configuration or alternate recovery policy is designed.

options.title: Narrow the fallback contract
options.body: Allow FTS-only degradation only for a more limited, maintainer-defined subset of valid existing indexes.

recommendation.title: Adopt FTS-only degradation
recommendation.body: Accept read-only lexical recall for implicit-provider outages and keep semantic-index writes blocked until the provider recovers.
